data.title: Is Bitcoin a 'Buy' Right Now? BlackRock Slashes ETF Swap Minimum 96% From $25M to $1M
data.description: BlackRock has cut the minimum Bitcoin-to-IBIT in-kind conversion from $25 million to $1 million, a 96% reduction. IBIT has already processed more than $5 billion ...
